patient.name: Arenla Ao
patient.caregiver_notes: Loves traditional Naga folk melodies, enjoys sitting by the veranda looking at the orchids. Speaks Nagamese and English.

photos.notes: Moa who brings you morning Assam tea and fresh oranges.
Sentila who studies in Dimapur and loves singing hymns with you.
Imti from Ungma village who always brings bamboo shoot pickles.
Aienla who weaves lovely traditional shawls and cooks your favourite stew.

voiceNotes.label: Morning Greeting from Sentila
voiceNotes.transcript: Good morning Ayo! May your day be blessed with sunshine and sweet tea. I love you!

voiceNotes.label: Village Church Hymn Melody
voiceNotes.transcript: Singing gentle hills hymn: "How great Thou art" hummed warmly.

voiceNotes.label: Tea Time Reminder & Laughter
voiceNotes.transcript: Ayo, the kettle is whistling on the fire stove. Time for warm ginger tea!

reminders.label: Morning Warm Tea & Rice Cake
reminders.notes: Loves Lal Cha with a pinch of cardamom and warm steamed rice cake.

reminders.label: Morning Blood Pressure Tablet
reminders.notes: Small white pill after breakfast with half a glass of warm water.

reminders.label: Sip Fresh Water & Sit in Garden
reminders.notes: Gentle hydration while watching the green hills from veranda.

reminders.label: Gentle Veranda Walk & Hymn Listening
reminders.notes: Walking 10 minutes near the potted orchids in the courtyard.

supportContacts.name: Moa Jamir (Son)
supportContacts.notes: Lives in the same house. First person to call.

supportContacts.name: Lipokla (ASHA Worker)
supportContacts.notes: Visits every Tuesday for routine vitals and friendly chat.

supportContacts.name: Sentila (Granddaughter)
supportContacts.notes: Available on video calls and phone every afternoon.

activityLogs.descriptive_note: Arenla Ao spent comfortable time with family photo recognition today, enjoying moments with family memories.
Arenla warmly recognized photos of Moa and Sentila, smiling gently when talking about village memories.
Listened attentively to the church hymn voice note and hummed along with a peaceful expression.

familiarPlaces.name: Mokokchung Town & Hills
familiarPlaces.prompt_clue: The misty blue hills where the morning roosters call across the pine trees.
familiarPlaces.memory_fact: Where the family home has stood for over forty years.

familiarPlaces.name: Village Baptist Church
familiarPlaces.prompt_clue: The wooden church with the white steeple where Sunday hymns fill the morning air.
familiarPlaces.memory_fact: Where you loved singing in the choir during Easter and Christmas.

familiarPlaces.name: The Veranda & Orchid Garden
familiarPlaces.prompt_clue: The peaceful wooden porch with yellow wild orchids hanging in bamboo pots.
familiarPlaces.memory_fact: Your favourite spot for enjoying warm ginger tea in the golden afternoon light.

familiarPlaces.name: Dzukou Valley Flower Meadows
familiarPlaces.prompt_clue: The rolling emerald green valleys where wild lilies bloom under gentle clouds.
familiarPlaces.memory_fact: A famous mountain valley visited with loved ones during harvest time.
